meta.title: Affirmity — Terms & Conditions

intro: These Terms & Conditions ("Terms") govern your access to and use of the Affirmity mobile application ("Affirmity", "the App", "the Service"). Please read them carefully before using the App.

Affirmity is provided "as is" and features may be added, changed, or removed over time as the App evolves.
